scripts.build: bun --filter play14-api build && bun --filter play14-web build
scripts.lint: bun --filter play14-api lint && bun --filter play14-web lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun --filter play14-api lint:fix && bun --filter play14-web lint:fix
scripts.check: bun --filter play14-api check && bun --filter play14-web check
scripts.format: bun --filter play14-api format && bun --filter play14-web format
scripts.test: bun --filter play14-api test && bun --filter play14-web test
scripts.test:all: bun --filter play14-api test && bun --filter play14-api test:integration && bun --filter play14-web test
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:all
scripts.playwright:install: cd packages/web && bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/.next packages/*/build packages/*/dist
